typesense:trending.greeting:
*The morning at U.A. had been unusually calm—until a line of unfamiliar buses stopped outside the main entrance.*

*Students from Kurogane Hero Academy stepped onto the grounds, dressed in dark uniforms bearing their school’s emblem. They moved with a quiet confidence, surveying U.A. without the usual excitement of visiting students.*

*Class 1-A watched from the entrance as their teacher approached alongside several Kurogane instructors.*

*“They’re here,”* *Aizawa said flatly.* *“Try not to start a fight before the first exercise.”*

*One of the Kurogane students glanced toward the class, then gave a faint, unimpressed smile.*

*“So this is U.A.’s famous Class 1-A?”*

*His eyes moved across the group.*

*“Honestly… I expected more.”*

*Bakugo’s eye twitched.*

*“The hell did you just say?”*

*The Kurogane student only smiled.*

*“Good. At least one of you looks ready to prove me wrong.”*
typesense:trending.name: MHA
typesense:trending.title: Another hero academy arrives claiming U.A. has become complacent.

title_i18n.ar: أكاديمية بطل أخرى تصل مدعية أن يو.إيه. أصبحت متراخية.
title_i18n.de: Eine weitere Heldenakademie trifft ein und behauptet, U.A. sei selbstgefällig geworden.
title_i18n.es: Otra academia de héroes llega afirmando que U.A. se ha vuelto complaciente.
title_i18n.fr: Une autre académie de héros arrive en affirmant que l'U.A. est devenue complaisante.
title_i18n.hi: एक और हीरो अकादमी आ गई है और दावा कर रही है कि U.A. आत्मसंतुष्ट हो चुकी है।
title_i18n.it: Un'altra accademia di eroi arriva affermando che U.A. è diventata compiacente.
title_i18n.ja: もう一つのヒーローアカデミーが到着し、U.A.が油断していると主張する。
title_i18n.ko: 또 다른 영웅 아카데미가 U.A.가 안주했다고 주장하며 도착한다.
title_i18n.pl: Inna akademia bohaterów przybywa twierdząc, że U.A. stała się samozadowolona.
title_i18n.pt: Outra academia de heróis chega alegando que a U.A. se tornou complacente.
title_i18n.ru: В U.A. прибывает другая академия героев, заявляя, что школа стала самодовольной.
title_i18n.tr: Başka bir kahraman akademisi U.A.'nın rehavete kapıldığını iddia ederek geliyor.
title_i18n.zh: 另一所英雄学院抵达，声称U.A.已变得自满。
